class.name: SteamServerStatsOperation
class.brief_description: Retained result of one Steam GameServer stats operation.
class.description: Local observation is bounded to 15 seconds. Steam may still complete an issued store after local cancellation, departure, or timeout. The same account stays fenced while its earlier Steam call drains, preventing accidental replay of a pending update.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Report whether the observation has a terminal result.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the settled result, or null while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Return the terminal [SteamServerStatsResult] or a signal to await for that result.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Settle a pending observer with [constant ERR_SKIP] and stop any edit still waiting on a load. A store already issued to Steam can still persist. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] once the observer is settled.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once the terminal result is stored on this operation.
